name: tooltip-radix
title: Tooltip
description: A short text label that appears on hover or keyboard focus, built on Radix Tooltip with a theme-inverted bubble and arrow.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>
docs:
Installed `tooltip.tsx` in `components/ui`.

Import: `import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"`

```tsx
<TooltipProvider>
  <Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
      <Button variant="outline">Save</Button>
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent>Saves a draft</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</TooltipProvider>
```

Colors and radius come from your theme's shadcn tokens (--primary, --border, --radius, and so on).
Enter and exit animations use tw-animate-css; import it in your global CSS.
